question: Who among the following was the first Indian Governor of the Reserve Bank of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**CD Deshmukh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **CD Deshmukh was the first Indian Governor of the Reserve Bank of India**.
 
• **Sir Chintaman Dwarakanath Deshmukh**, CIE, ICS (14 January 1896 – 2 October 1982) was an Indian civil servant and the first Indian[5] to be appointed the Governor of the Reserve Bank of India in 1943 by the British Raj authorities.
 
 
• He subsequently served as the Finance Minister in the Union Cabinet (1950–1956).
 
• It was during this time that he also became a **founding member of the Governing Body of NCAER**, the National Council of Applied Economic Research in New Delhi, India's first independent economic policy institute established in 1956 at the behest of Prime Minister Jawaharlal Nehru.
 
• After their resignation from Union Cabinet, he worked as Chairman of UGC (1956–1961).
 
• He served as **Vice-Chancellor of the University of Delhi (1962–67)**.
 
• He was also President of the Indian Statistical Institute from 1945 to 1964, Honorary Chairman of the National Book Trust (1957–60).
 
• He founded** India International Center in 1959** and served as Lifetime President of it.
 
• He was also** chairman of the Indian Institute of Public Administration**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Morarji Ranchhodji Desai** was an Indian independence activist and politician who served as the **4th Prime Minister of India** between 1977 and 1979 leading the government formed by the Janata Party. 
 
• **Nawabzada Liaquat Ali Khan**, widely known as Quaid-e-Millat and Shaheed-e-Millat, was a Pakistani statesman, lawyer, political theorist, and one of the leading founding fathers of Pakistan.
 
• **Kshitish Chandra Neogy**, also known as KC Neogy, was an Indian politician from West Bengal.
 
 
• He was a member of the Constituent Assembly of India, a member of the first Cabinet of independent India, and the chairman of the first Finance Commission of India.
 
 
 
• The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) is India's central bank and regulatory body and is responsible for the issue and supply of the Indian rupee and the regulation of the Indian banking system.
 
 
• It also manages the country's main payment systems and works to promote its economic development.
 
• Bharatiya Reserve Bank Note Mudran is one of the specialized divisions of RBI through which it mints Indian banknotes and coins.
